comments.body:
"Armour Devout" according to the rough translation, though I think it's also called "Godly Armour" in GAMA? Anyway, seems this can be plundered from Crimean Pirate Fleets at present. Stats are (assuming I've translated them correctly):

Tactics +2
Guard +1
Surgery +1

There's a matching helmet as well. Does anybody have further info on how to get these goodies?
